contracts: Only actual flags_only may select the new attribute callback. Physical own properties and fast arrays precede it; no full descriptor/value/existence-only path is changed.

The optional integrity callback is admission, not the operation implementation. A positive result continues the original algorithm; a negative result propagates its actual pending reason. Normal zero rejects before mutation/enumeration.
Proxy dispatch remains first and never receives the direct-object SEALED/FROZEN hook mode. Its existing target prevention uses NONE, and its existing trap/false diagnostics remain unchanged.
No pending-slot clearing, polling, native-event classification, callback result substitute, process.env consumer or global Engine policy is introduced.
Append-only struct fields require rebuilding consumers against the current header. Existing designated/zero-default initializers leave both hooks absent.
